words.gram: pres. part. ātm. √brū, m. nom. sg.

hindi: सिर मुँड़ाया हुआ या जटाधारी, पर्वत की गुफा में रहने वाला, चार सौ वर्ष की आयु बताने वाला, बहुत-से जटाधारी शिष्यों वाला व्यक्ति नगर के समीप ठहरे।
english: Shaven-headed or matted-haired, dwelling in a mountain cave, declaring a lifespan of four hundred years, with many matted-haired pupils, [the agent] should stay near the city.
notes: The subject is not stated in the unit; the person described is evidently the agent of the chapter's scheme. ante-vāsin is literally 'dwelling near', i.e. pupil; taken so here and in 6.
lines_deva: मुण्डो जटिलो वा पर्वत.गुह.आवासी चतुर्.वर्ष.शत.आयुर् ब्रुवाणः प्रभूत.जटिल.अन्ते.वासी नगर.अभ्याशे तिष्ठेत्
lines_iast: muṇḍo jaṭilo vā parvata.guha.āvāsī catur.varṣa.śata.āyur bruvāṇaḥ prabhūta.jaṭila.ante.vāsī nagara.abhyāśe tiṣṭhet

words.gloss: by offerings of roots and fruits

hindi: और उसके शिष्य मूल और फलों की भेंट से मन्त्रियों और राजा को भगवान् के दर्शन के लिए प्रवृत्त करें।
english: And his pupils, with offerings of roots and fruits, should engage the ministers and the king to see the Venerable One.
notes: upagamana is literally 'approach'; 'offering' is the sense in the context. yojayeyuḥ is literally 'should join/engage'; 'induce' would be an interpretation. bhagavat is the honorific for the ascetic of unit 1.
lines_deva: शिष्याश् च-अस्य मूल.फल.उपगमनैर् अमात्यान् राजानं च भगवद्.दर्शनाय योजयेयुः
lines_iast: śiṣyāś ca-asya mūla.phala.upagamanair amātyān rājānaṃ ca bhagavad.darśanāya yojayeyuḥ

words.gloss: tokens of recognition about former kings and countries
(editors' doubtful alternative reading, same word as the preceding vṛṇīṣva)

hindi: और राजा से मिलकर वह पहले के राजाओं और देशों के पहचान-चिह्न बताए, “प्रत्येक सौ वर्ष पूरे होने पर मैं अग्नि में प्रवेश करके फिर बालक हो जाता हूँ; इसलिए यहाँ आपके समीप मैं चौथी अग्नि में प्रवेश करूँगा; मेरे द्वारा आप अवश्य सम्मान किए जाने योग्य हैं; तीन वर चुनिए।”
english: And, having met with the king, he should relate tokens of recognition concerning former kings and countries: “At the completion of every hundred years I enter the fire and become a child again. So here, near your honour, I shall enter the fourth fire. By me you must certainly be honoured. Choose three boons.”

text_flags.why: possible typo: kathayet is singular, so nominative singular samāgataḥ + ca (-> samāgataś ca) is expected; printed -tāś would be a plural
the editors' own doubt mark; vṛṣīṣva is not a regular form of √vṛ and vṛṇīṣva is printed just before it; kept as a doubtful variant, not applied

notes: The editors' alternative '(vṛṣīṣva?)' is not translated. caturtham agnim is literally 'the fourth fire'; the sense may be 'for the fourth time'. 'me ... mānayitavyaḥ' is literally 'by me you are to be honoured'. pūrva-rāja-deśa could also be read 'the countries of former kings'. bhavat samīpe: bhavat is the compound form of bhavān.
lines_deva: समागताश् च राज्ञा पूर्व.राज.देश.अभिज्ञानानि कथयेत्, "शते शते च वर्षाणां पूर्णे ऽहम् अग्निं प्रविश्य पुनर् बालो भवामि, तद् इह भवत् समीपे चतुर्थम् अग्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि, अवश्यं मे भवान् मानयितव्यः, त्रीन् वरान् वृणीष्व (वृषीष्व?)" इति
lines_iast: samāgatāś ca rājñā pūrva.rāja.deśa.abhijñānāni kathayet, "śate śate ca varṣāṇāṃ pūrṇe 'ham agniṃ praviśya punar bālo bhavāmi, tad iha bhavat samīpe caturtham agniṃ pravekṣyāmi, avaśyaṃ me bhavān mānayitavyaḥ, trīn varān vṛṇīṣva (vṛṣīṣva?)" iti

hindi: स्वीकार करने वाले से वह कहे, “सात रात यहाँ पुत्र और स्त्री के साथ, प्रेक्षा और प्रहवण पहले करके, रहना चाहिए।”
english: To the one who has agreed he should say: “[You] must stay here for seven nights together with [your] son and wife, with spectacles and prahavaṇas first.”
notes: prahavaṇa is obscure and its sense is not settled; kept untranslated. prekṣā = spectacle, show. dāra is normally plural; the bahuvrīhi saputra-dāra is singular and is rendered literally 'together with son and wife'.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं ब्रूयात् "सप्त.रात्रम् इह सपुत्र.दारेण प्रेक्षा.प्रहवण.पूर्वं वस्तव्यम्" इति
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ brūyāt "sapta.rātram iha saputra.dāreṇa prekṣā.prahavaṇa.pūrvaṃ vastavyam" iti

hindi: रहने वाले पर आक्रमण करे।
english: He should assault the one who is staying.
notes: The subject and the one staying are not stated; by units 4 and 10 the one staying is the person who agreed to stay seven nights.
lines_deva: वसन्तम् अवस्कन्देत
lines_iast: vasantam avaskandeta

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a sthānika
for the purpose of the termites' following

hindi: सिर मुँड़ाया हुआ या जटाधारी, स्थानिक के वेश वाला, बहुत-से जटाधारी शिष्यों वाला गुप्तचर बकरे के रक्त से लिप्त बाँस की शलाका को सोने के चूर्ण से लीपकर दीमकों के पीछे आने के लिए बाँबी में रखे, अथवा सोने की नली को।
english: Shaven-headed or matted-haired, an agent in the guise of a sthānika, with many matted-haired pupils, having smeared a bamboo rod, daubed with goat's blood, with gold powder, should place it in an anthill for the purpose of the termites' following; or a golden tube.
notes: sthānika is obscure here (literally 'belonging to a place/station'); the name is kept. upajihvika is taken as termites / white ants. anusaraṇa is literally 'following'; what is meant (the termites gathering at the rod) is not stated. 'it' after 'should place' is supplied to carry over the object; the final 'or a golden tube' is another object of nidadhyāt.
lines_deva: मुण्डो वा जटिलो वा स्थानिक.व्यञ्जनः प्रभूत.जटिल.अन्ते.वासी वस्त.शोणित.दिग्धां वेणु.शलाकां सुवर्ण.चूर्णेन-अवलिप्य वल्मीके निदध्याद् उपजिह्विक.अनुसरण.अर्थम्, स्वर्ण.नालिकां वा
lines_iast: muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vā sthānika.vyañjanaḥ prabhūta.jaṭila.ante.vāsī vasta.śoṇita.digdhāṃ veṇu.śalākāṃ suvarṇa.cūrṇena-avalipya valmīke nidadhyād upajihvika.anusaraṇa.artham, svarṇa.nālikāṃ vā

hindi: तब गुप्तचर राजा से कहे, “वह सिद्ध पुष्पित निधि को जानता है।”
english: Then a secret agent should tell the king: “That holy man knows a blossomed treasure.”
notes: puṣpita nidhi is literally 'a flowered/blossomed treasure'; the intended sense is not stated and is not guessed. siddha is rendered 'holy man' after the glossary (siddha-vyañjana).
lines_deva: ततः सत्त्री राज्ञः कथयेत् "असौ सिद्धः पुष्पितं निधिं जानाति" इति
lines_iast: tataḥ sattrī rājñaḥ kathayet "asau siddhaḥ puṣpitaṃ nidhiṃ jānāti" iti

hindi: राजा के पूछने पर वह कहे, “ऐसा ही है”, और उस पहचान-चिह्न को दिखाए, अथवा और सोना भीतर रखकर।
english: He, asked by the king, should say, “So it is,” and should show that token, or [do so] having placed more gold inside.

text_flags.why: probable typo: 'asked' is pṛṣṭaḥ (p.p. of √prach); pṛṣṭha means 'back'

notes: Printed pṛṣṭhaḥ is also in the Devanagari (पृष्ठः). bhūyaḥ may be 'again' rather than 'more'; antar ādhāya has no stated object or place (presumably the anthill of unit 6). The English 'do so' is supplied.
lines_deva: स राज्ञा पृष्ठः "तथा" इति ब्रूयात्, तच् च-अभिज्ञानं दर्शयेत्, भूयो वा हिरण्यम् अन्तर्.आधाय
lines_iast: sa rājñā pṛṣṭhaḥ "tathā" iti brūyāt, tac ca-abhijñānaṃ darśayet, bhūyo vā hiraṇyam antar.ādhāya

hindi: और उससे कहे, “यह निधि नाग से रक्षित है, प्रणिपात से साध्य है।”
english: And he should say to him: “This treasure, guarded by a serpent, is to be won by prostration.”
notes: nāga is taken as 'serpent' (as in units 16 and 23); it can also mean elephant. sādhya is literally 'to be accomplished/gained'.
lines_deva: ब्रूयाच् च-एनं "नाग.रक्षितो ऽयं निधिः प्रणिपात.साध्यः" इति
lines_iast: brūyāc ca-enaṃ "nāga.rakṣito 'yaṃ nidhiḥ praṇipāta.sādhyaḥ" iti

hindi: स्वीकार करने वाले से वह कहे, “सात रात”; समान।
english: To the one who has agreed he should say, “Seven nights”; [it is] the same.
notes: samānam is read as a back-reference: the procedure is the same as in unit 4.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं ब्रूयात् "सप्त.रात्रम्" इति समानम्
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ brūyāt "sapta.rātram" iti samānam

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a sthānika

hindi: अथवा रात में एकान्त में तेजन-अग्नि से युक्त होकर ठहरे हुए, क्रम से लाए गए स्थानिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर के विषय में गुप्तचर राजा से कहें, “वह सिद्ध सामेधिक है।”
english: Or secret agents should tell the king of an agent in the guise of a sthānika, brought forward step by step, who stays at night in a secluded place provided with tejana-fire: “That holy man is a sāmedhika.”

text_flags.why: possible typo: long ī; the same phrase is printed krama.abhinītaṃ in unit 16 (abhi-nīta)

notes: tejana (as in units 23 and 25) and sāmedhika are obscure and left untranslated; krama-abhinīta is read 'brought forward in due order', its exact sense is uncertain. sthānika as in unit 6.
lines_deva: स्थानिक.व्यञ्जनं वा रात्रौ तेजन.अग्नि.युक्तम् एकान्ते तिष्ठन्तं सत्त्रिणः क्रम.अभीनीतं राज्ञः कथयेयुः "असौ सिद्धः सामेधिकः" इति
lines_iast: sthānika.vyañjanaṃ vā rātrau tejana.agni.yuktam ekānte tiṣṭhantaṃ sattriṇaḥ krama.abhīnītaṃ rājñaḥ kathayeyuḥ "asau siddhaḥ sāmedhikaḥ" iti

words.gram: fut. part. ātm. √kṛ, m. nom. sg.

hindi: उससे राजा जिस वस्तु को माँगे, उसे उसके लिए करने को उद्यत होकर वह कहे, “सात रात”; समान।
english: Of him, whatever object the king may ask for, he, intending to do that for him, [should say] “Seven nights”; [it is] the same.
notes: The verb 'should say' is not in the text. The roles are unclear: taṃ is read as the person asked (the holy man), asya as the king; the alternative reading reverses them.
lines_deva: तं राजा यम् अर्थं याचेत तम् अस्य करिष्यमाणः "सप्त.रात्रम्" इति समानम्
lines_iast: taṃ rājā yam arthaṃ yāceta tam asya kariṣyamāṇaḥ "sapta.rātram" iti samānam

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर राजा को जम्भक विद्याओं से लुभाए।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a holy man should entice the king with jambhaka sciences.
notes: jambhaka-vidyā is kept literal ('jambhaka sciences'); jambhaka is obscure and vidyā is not rendered 'spells'.
lines_deva: सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनो वा राजानं जम्भक.विद्याभिः प्रलोभयेत्
lines_iast: siddha.vyañjano vā rājānaṃ jambhaka.vidyābhiḥ pralobhayet

hindi: उसे राजा ... इति; समान।
english: “Him the king …” up to “iti”: the same [as before].
notes: Abbreviated back-reference: the unit repeats the wording of unit 12 ('taṃ rājā yam arthaṃ ... iti') and says it is the same; rājā-iti stands for 'rājā ... iti'. The literal rendering is kept.
lines_deva: तं राजा-इति समानम्
lines_iast: taṃ rājā-iti samānam

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a holy man

words.gram: inst. pl. (m. or n.; gender not determinable)

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर पूजित देश-देवता का आश्रय लेकर, प्रहवणों के द्वारा बार-बार प्रकृतियों के मुखियों को साथ बसाकर, क्रम से राजा को छले।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a holy man, having resorted to a venerated deity of the region, having repeatedly made the chiefs of the constituent elements dwell together by means of prahavaṇas, should gradually outwit the king.
notes: abhisaṃvāsya (abhi-sam-√vas caus.) is rendered literally; the sense (gathering the chiefs) is not certain. atisandadhyāt follows the glossary sense 'outwit'.
lines_deva: सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनो वा देश.देवताम् अभ्यर्हिताम् आश्रित्य प्रहवणैर् अभीक्ष्णं प्रकृति.मुख्यान् अभिसंवास्य क्रमेण राजानम् अतिसन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: siddha.vyañjano vā deśa.devatām abhyarhitām āśritya prahavaṇair abhīkṣṇaṃ prakṛti.mukhyān abhisaṃvāsya krameṇa rājānam atisandadhyāt

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a matted-haired ascetic
having a bank, tunnel and underground chamber as retreat

hindi: क्रम से लाए गए, जटाधारी के वेश वाले, अथवा जल के भीतर रहने वाले, सब ओर से श्वेत, तट, सुरंग और भूमिगृह से निकल भागने वाले, वरुण या नागराज के रूप में उस गुप्तचर के विषय में गुप्तचर राजा से कहें।
english: Secret agents should tell the king of an agent in the guise of a matted-haired ascetic, or one dwelling inside the water, all white, with a bank, a tunnel and an underground chamber as his retreat, [as] Varuna or a serpent-king, brought forward step by step.
notes: The grammar of the accusative series is loose: Varuna / the serpent-king stand in apposition ('[as]' is supplied). The two 'vā' may divide the series differently. nāga-rāja is read 'serpent-king'. apasaraṇa is literally 'going away / retreat'.
lines_deva: जटिल.व्यञ्जनम् अन्तर्.उदक.वासिनं वा सर्व.श्वेतं तट.सुरुङ्गा.भूमि.गृह.अपसरणं वरुणं नाग.राजं वा सत्त्रिणः क्रम.अभिनीतं राज्ञः कथयेयुः
lines_iast: jaṭila.vyañjanam antar.udaka.vāsinaṃ vā sarva.śvetaṃ taṭa.suruṅgā.bhūmi.gṛha.apasaraṇaṃ varuṇaṃ nāga.rājaṃ vā sattriṇaḥ krama.abhinītaṃ rājñaḥ kathayeyuḥ

hindi: उसे राजा ... इति; समान।
english: “Him the king …” up to “iti”: the same [as before].
notes: Abbreviated back-reference, as in unit 14 (repeating unit 12's wording).
lines_deva: तं राजा-इति समानम्
lines_iast: taṃ rājā-iti samānam

words.gloss: dwelling at the border of the country
agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: अथवा जनपद की सीमा पर रहने वाला, सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर राजा को शत्रु को देखने के लिए प्रवृत्त करे।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a holy man, dwelling at the border of the country, should engage the king to see the enemy.
notes: jana-pada-ante-vāsin is read 'dwelling at the border of the country' (cf. unit 1, where ante-vāsin means pupil); the Sanskrit does not name him an agent except through vyañjana.
lines_deva: जन.पद.अन्ते.वासी सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनो वा राजानं शत्रु.दर्शनाय योजयेत्
lines_iast: jana.pada.ante.vāsī siddha.vyañjano vā rājānaṃ śatru.darśanāya yojayet

words.gram: caus. abs. in -tvā (irregular after prefix ā-) ā-√vah

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने पर बिम्ब बनाकर, शत्रु को बुलाकर, बन्द स्थान में मरवा दे।
english: [When he has] agreed, having made an image, having summoned the enemy, he should have [him] killed in a confined place.
notes: pratipannam is hard to place (here no verb of saying; in 40 and 43 it is the object of ghātayeyuḥ). bimba (image / reflection / likeness) is not explained: whose image, and what for, is not stated. Alternative: 'having made the one who has agreed into an image'.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं बिम्बं कृत्वा शत्रुम् आवाहयित्वा निरुद्धे देशे घातयेत्
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ bimbaṃ kṛtvā śatrum āvāhayitvā niruddhe deśe ghātayet

words.gloss: agents in the guise of traders
for the purpose of presenting goods

hindi: घोड़ों को बिक्री का माल बनाकर आए, व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर माल भेंट करने के निमित्त राजा को बुलाकर, माल की परीक्षा में लगे हुए अथवा घोड़ों के बीच मिले हुए राजा को मार डालें, और घोड़ों से प्रहार करें।
english: Agents in the guise of traders, come with horses as merchandise, having invited the king for the purpose of presenting the goods, should kill him, engrossed in examining the goods or mingled among horses, and should strike with horses.
notes: upāyana is 'presenting / offering'; vyatikīrṇa is literally 'intermingled, scattered about'.
lines_deva: अश्व.पण्य.उपयाता वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनाः पण्य.उपायन.निमित्तम् आहूय राजानं पण्य.परीक्षायाम् आसक्तम् अश्व.व्यतिकीर्णं वा हन्युः, अश्वैश् च प्रहरेयुः
lines_iast: aśva.paṇya.upayātā vaidehaka.vyañjanāḥ paṇya.upāyana.nimittam āhūya rājānaṃ paṇya.parīkṣāyām āsaktam aśva.vyatikīrṇaṃ vā hanyuḥ, aśvaiś ca prahareyuḥ

hindi: अथवा नगर के समीप रात में चैत्य पर चढ़कर तीक्ष्ण, घड़ों में नलिकाओं या विदुलों को फूँकते हुए, अस्पष्ट रूप से कहें, “हम स्वामी या मुख्यों का मांस खाएँगे; हमारे लिए पूजा हो।”
english: Or, having climbed a caitya near the city at night, assassins, blowing tubes or vidulas in pots, should say indistinctly: “We shall eat the flesh of the king or of the chiefs; let there be worship for us.”
notes: caitya (a sacred shrine or tree) is kept as a name. vidula is obscure and left untranslated. kumbheṣu is locative; nālīn and vidulāni are the accusative objects of dhamantaḥ ('blowing tubes or vidulas in pots'). In Hindi तीक्ष्ण stands alone (glossary), set off by commas. 'pūjā no vartatām' is literally 'let worship be/go on for us'. svāmin = king per glossary.
lines_deva: नगर.अभ्याशे वा चैत्यम् आरुह्य रात्रौ तीक्ष्णाः कुम्भेषु नालीन् वा विदुलानि धमन्तः "स्वामिनो मुख्यानां वा मांसानि भक्षयिष्यामः, पूजा नो वर्तताम्" इत्य् अव्यक्तं ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: nagara.abhyāśe vā caityam āruhya rātrau tīkṣṇāḥ kumbheṣu nālīn vā vidulāni dhamantaḥ "svāmino mukhyānāṃ vā māṃsāni bhakṣayiṣyāmaḥ, pūjā no vartatām" ity avyaktaṃ brūyuḥ

words.gloss: agents in the guise of omen-readers and astrologers
words.gram: bahuvrīhi (first member a dvandva), m. nom. pl.

hindi: नैमित्तिक और मौहूर्तिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर इनके सम्बन्ध में उसकी घोषणा करें।
english: Agents in the guise of naimittikas (omen-readers) and astrologers should proclaim that concerning these.
notes: eṣām (literally 'of these') has no clear referent; it may mean 'to these' (the townspeople) or 'of these' (the assassins' doings). naimittika is literally 'one who reads nimittas (omens)'.
lines_deva: तद् एषां नैमित्तिक.मौहूर्तिक.व्यञ्जनाः ख्यापयेयुः
lines_iast: tad eṣāṃ naimittika.mauhūrtika.vyañjanāḥ khyāpayeyuḥ

words.gloss: in the middle of a pond

words.gram: pres. part. caus. niṣ-√piṣ, m. nom. pl.

hindi: अथवा मंगलकारी सरोवर में या तालाब के बीच रात में तेजन तेल से लिपे हुए, नागों का रूप धारण किए, लोहे की बनी शक्तियों और मूसलों को घिसते हुए उसी प्रकार कहें।
english: Or, in an auspicious lake or in the middle of a pond, at night, anointed with tejana oil, in serpent forms, grinding iron lances and clubs, they should speak in just that way.
notes: niṣpeṣayantaḥ is literally 'causing to be ground/crushed' (possibly 'striking together noisily'). musala = pestle-like club. 'In that way' refers back to the speech of unit 21. nāga = serpent.
lines_deva: मङ्गल्ये वा ह्रदे तटाक.मध्ये वा रात्रौ तेजन.तैल.अभ्यक्ता नाग.रूपिणः शक्ति.मुसलान्य् अयोमयानि निष्पेषयन्तस् तथैव ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: maṅgalye vā hrade taṭāka.madhye vā rātrau tejana.taila.abhyaktā nāga.rūpiṇaḥ śakti.musalāny ayomayāni niṣpeṣayantas tathaiva brūyuḥ

words.gloss: furnished with emission of fire and smoke

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. √kṛ, m. nom. pl.

words.gloss: in the intervals of the cries of dogs and jackals

hindi: अथवा भालू की खाल के कंचुक पहने, अग्नि और धुएँ को निकालने से युक्त, राक्षस का रूप धारण किए, नगर को तीन बार अपसव्य करते हुए, कुत्तों और सियारों के चिल्लाने के अन्तरालों में उसी प्रकार कहें।
english: Or, wearing jackets of bear-skin, furnished with the emission of fire and smoke, bearing the form of a demon, making the city thrice apasavya, in the intervals of the cries of dogs and jackals, they should speak in just that way.
notes: apasavya is kept (it is the reverse of the sunwise circuit); 'making the city apasavya' is the literal form. rakṣas = demon. The two words of 'tathaiva' are joined in the print.
lines_deva: ऋक्ष.चर्म.कञ्चुकिनो वा-अग्नि.धूम.उत्सर्ग.युक्ता रक्षो.रूपं वहन्तस् त्रिर् अपसव्यं नगरं कुर्वाणाः श्व.सृगाल.वाशित.अन्तरेषु तथैव ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: ṛkṣa.carma.kañcukino vā-agni.dhūma.utsarga.yuktā rakṣo.rūpaṃ vahantas trir apasavyaṃ nagaraṃ kurvāṇāḥ śva.sṛgāla.vāśita.antareṣu tathaiva brūyuḥ

words.gloss: image of the deity of a caitya
covered by a layer of abhra

hindi: अथवा चैत्य के देवता की प्रतिमा को रात में तेजन तेल से या अभ्र की परत से ढकी हुई अग्नि से जलाकर उसी प्रकार कहें।
english: Or, having made an image of the deity of a caitya blaze at night with tejana oil, or with fire covered by a layer of abhra, they should speak in just that way.
notes: abhra is literally 'cloud' and also 'mica'; the sense here is uncertain. The print joins tailena-abhra-…-channena-agninā by hyphens; the instruments are read as 'tejana oil' and 'fire covered by a layer of abhra'.
lines_deva: चैत्य.दैवत.प्रतिमां वा तेजन.तैलेन-अभ्र.पटलच्.छन्नेन-अग्निना वा रात्रौ प्रज्वाल्य तथैव ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: caitya.daivata.pratimāṃ vā tejana.tailena-abhra.paṭalac.channena-agninā vā rātrau prajvālya tathaiva brūyuḥ

hindi: दूसरे उसकी घोषणा करें।
english: Others should proclaim that.
lines_deva: तद् अन्ये ख्यापयेयुः
lines_iast: tad anye khyāpayeyuḥ

hindi: देवताओं की प्रतिमाओं से या पूजित प्रतिमाओं से रक्त का अत्यधिक प्रवाह करें।
english: They should make an excessive flow of blood from images of deities or from the venerated ones.
notes: śoṇitena prasrāvam is literally 'a flow, by blood'; 'from' follows the genitive pratimānām. abhyarhitānām may agree with pratimānām (the venerated images) or stand alone.
lines_deva: दैवत.प्रतिमानाम् अभ्यर्हितानां वा शोणितेन प्रस्रावम् अतिमात्रं कुर्युः
lines_iast: daivata.pratimānām abhyarhitānāṃ vā śoṇitena prasrāvam atimātraṃ kuryuḥ

words.gloss: at the flowing of the god's blood

hindi: दूसरे उसे कहें कि देवता के रक्त के बहने पर संग्राम में पराजय होगी।
english: Others should declare that, at the flowing of the god's blood, [there will be] defeat in battle.
notes: deva may be singular or plural ('god' or 'gods'); tad is read as object ('that'), or 'on that'. The verb 'will be' is supplied.
lines_deva: तद् अन्ये देव.रुधिर.संस्रावे सङ्ग्रामे पराजयं ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: tad anye deva.rudhira.saṃsrāve saṅgrāme parājayaṃ brūyuḥ

words.gloss: at the front of a cremation ground

hindi: सन्धि-रात्रियों में अथवा श्मशान के सामने चैत्य को ऊपर की ओर खाए हुए मनुष्यों के साथ प्रकट करें।
english: On junction-nights, or at the front of a cremation ground, they should present a caitya with men eaten upwards.
notes: Obscure. sandhi-rātri is literally 'night of a junction' (turning-point of a period); the glossary's 'treaty' does not apply. ūrdhva-bhakṣita ('eaten upwards / from above') and prarūpayeyuḥ ('should represent, make appear') are rendered literally; the picture (corpses displayed at the caitya?) is not asserted.
lines_deva: सन्धि.रात्रिषु श्मशान.प्रमुखे वा चैत्यम् ऊर्ध्व.भक्षितैर् मनुष्यैः प्ररूपयेयुः
lines_iast: sandhi.rātriṣu śmaśāna.pramukhe vā caityam ūrdhva.bhakṣitair manuṣyaiḥ prarūpayeyuḥ

hindi: तब राक्षस का रूप धारण करने वाला, मनुष्य को माँगे।
english: Then one in the form of a demon should ask for a man.
notes: manuṣyaka is manuṣya with the suffix -ka (small/familiar); rendered 'a man'.
lines_deva: ततो रक्षो.रूपी मनुष्यकं याचेत
lines_iast: tato rakṣo.rūpī manuṣyakaṃ yāceta

hindi: और जो यहाँ शूरता की बात करने वाला या कोई अन्य देखने आए, उसे दूसरे लोहे के मूसलों से मारें, जिससे यह जाना जाए कि वह राक्षसों द्वारा मारा गया।
english: And whoever here, one who talks of heroism or any other, should come to see, him others should strike with iron clubs, so that it may be known that he was killed by demons.
notes: śūra-vādika is literally 'hero-talker' (braggart). 'yathā ... iti jñāyeta' is read 'so that it may be known that ...'.
lines_deva: यश् च-अत्र शूर.वादिको ऽन्यतमो वा द्रष्टुम् आगच्छेत् तम् अन्ये लोह.मुसलैर् हन्युः, यथा रक्षोभिर् हत इति ज्ञायेत
lines_iast: yaś ca-atra śūra.vādiko 'nyatamo vā draṣṭum āgacchet tam anye loha.musalair hanyuḥ, yathā rakṣobhir hata iti jñāyeta

hindi: उस आश्चर्य को उसे देखने वाले और गुप्तचर राजा से कहें।
english: Those who saw it, and the secret agents, should report that marvel to the king.
lines_deva: तद् अद्भुतं राज्ञस् तद्.दर्शिनः सत्त्रिणश् च कथयेयुः
lines_iast: tad adbhutaṃ rājñas tad.darśinaḥ sattriṇaś ca kathayeyuḥ

words.gloss: agents in the guise of omen-readers and astrologers
words.gram: bahuvrīhi (first member a dvandva), m. nom. pl.

hindi: तब नैमित्तिक और मौहूर्तिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर शान्ति और प्रायश्चित्त बताएँ, “अन्यथा राजा और देश का बड़ा अमंगल होगा।”
english: Then agents in the guise of omen-readers and astrologers should declare pacification and expiation: “Otherwise [there will be] great ill for the king and the country.”

text_flags.why: typo: letters transposed (naimititka for naimittika); cf. unit 22

notes: The print has naimititka.mauhūrtika.vyañjanāḥ (and the Devanagari नैमितित्क). The verb 'there will be' is supplied.
lines_deva: ततो नैमितित्क.मौहूर्तिक.व्यञ्जनाः शान्तिं प्रायश्.चित्तं ब्रूयुः "अन्यथा महद् अकुशलं राज्ञो देशस्य च" इति
lines_iast: tato naimititka.mauhūrtika.vyañjanāḥ śāntiṃ prāyaś.cittaṃ brūyuḥ "anyathā mahad akuśalaṃ rājño deśasya ca" iti

words.gloss: one mantra, offering and oblation each
words.gram: dvandva (with distributive eka-eka), n. collective, nom. sg.

hindi: स्वीकार करने वाले से वे कहें, “इन में सात रात तक एक-एक मन्त्र, बलि और होम स्वयं राजा को करना चाहिए।”
english: To the one who has agreed they should say: “In these, for seven nights, one mantra, offering (bali) and oblation (homa) each must be performed by the king himself.”
notes: eka-eka-mantra-bali-homam is read as a dvandva (n., collective) with distributive eka-eka and taken as the subject of kartavyam: 'one mantra, offering and oblation each'; no noun such as 'rite' is supplied. The exact distribution (one for each portent, or one per night) is not stated. eteṣu = in these (presumably the portents of units 21-29).
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं "एतेषु सप्त.रात्रम् एक.एक.मन्त्र.बलि.होमं स्वयं राज्ञा कर्तव्यम्" इति ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ "eteṣu sapta.rātram eka.eka.mantra.bali.homaṃ svayaṃ rājñā kartavyam" iti brūyuḥ

hindi: तब समान।
english: Then [it is] the same.
notes: A back-reference to the earlier procedure (as units 10 and 12); not further specified.
lines_deva: ततः समानम्
lines_iast: tataḥ samānam

hindi: अथवा इन योगों को अपने में दिखाकर वह दूसरों के उपदेश के लिए उनका प्रतिकार करे।
english: Or, having shown these contrivances in himself, he should counter [them], for the instruction of others.
notes: The subject is not stated. ātmani is literally 'in himself' (also 'on his own side'). pareṣām may mean 'of others' or 'of enemies'; yoga = secret contrivance (Book 12 sense).
lines_deva: एतान् वा योगान् आत्मनि दर्शयित्वा प्रतिकुर्वीत परेषाम् उपदेश.अर्थम्
lines_iast: etān vā yogān ātmani darśayitvā pratikurvīta pareṣām upadeśa.artham

hindi: तब योगों का प्रयोग करे।
english: Then he should employ the contrivances.
lines_deva: ततः प्रयोजयेद् योगान्
lines_iast: tataḥ prayojayed yogān

words.gloss: by the countering of the display of contrivances

hindi: अथवा योग-दर्शन के प्रतिकार से कोश का संग्रह करे।
english: Or, by the countering of the display of contrivances, he should effect the collecting of the treasury.
notes: yoga-darśana-pratīkāra can be taken 'countering of the display of yogas' or 'display of the yogas and the counter-measure'.
lines_deva: योग.दर्शन.प्रतीकारेण वा कोश.अभिसंहरणं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: yoga.darśana.pratīkāreṇa vā kośa.abhisaṃharaṇaṃ kuryāt

hindi: अथवा हाथी के शौकीन को हाथियों के वन के रक्षक शुभ लक्षणों वाले हाथी से लुभाएँ।
english: Or the keepers of the elephant forest should entice one fond of elephants with an elephant having auspicious marks.
notes: nāga here is 'elephant' (nāga-vana), unlike units 9, 16, 23. lakṣaṇya = bearing (good) marks.
lines_deva: हस्ति.कामं वा नाग.वन.पाला हस्तिना लक्षण्येन प्रलोभयेयुः
lines_iast: hasti.kāmaṃ vā nāga.vana.pālā hastinā lakṣaṇyena pralobhayeyuḥ

hindi: स्वीकार करने वाले को घने वन या एक ही मार्ग वाले स्थान से होकर ले जाकर मरवा दें, अथवा बाँधकर हर ले जाएँ।
english: Having led the one who has agreed through a thicket or a single-track path, they should have him killed, or, having bound him, should carry him off.
notes: eka-ayana is literally 'one way / single path'; sense 'narrow, lonely path' is a guess. The object pratipannam is carried to both verbs.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं गहनम् एक.अयनं वा-अतिनीय घातयेयुः, बद्ध्वा वा-अपहरेयुः
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ gahanam eka.ayanaṃ vā-atinīya ghātayeyuḥ, baddhvā vā-apahareyuḥ

hindi: इससे शिकार के इच्छुक की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By that, [the case of] one fond of hunting is explained.
lines_deva: तेन मृगया.कामो व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: tena mṛgayā.kāmo vyākhyātaḥ

words.gloss: one greedy for wealth and women
for the purpose of an inheritance and a deposit

hindi: धन और स्त्रियों के लोभी को गुप्तचर धनी विधवाओं से, अथवा परम रूप और यौवन वाली, उत्तराधिकार और धरोहर के निमित्त लाई गई स्त्रियों से लुभाएँ।
english: Secret agents should entice one greedy for wealth and women with wealthy widows, or with women of supreme beauty and youth, brought forward for the purpose of an inheritance and a deposit.
notes: dāya may be 'inheritance, share' or 'gift'; nikṣepa = deposit. Whether the last phrase covers the widows as well as the women is not certain.
lines_deva: द्रव्य.स्त्री.लोलुपम् आढ्य.विधवाभिर् वा परम.रूप.यौवनाभिः स्त्रीभिर् दाय.निक्षेप.अर्थम् उपनीताभिः सत्त्रिणः प्रलोभयेयुः
lines_iast: dravya.strī.lolupam āḍhya.vidhavābhir vā parama.rūpa.yauvanābhiḥ strībhir dāya.nikṣepa.artham upanītābhiḥ sattriṇaḥ pralobhayeyuḥ

hindi: स्वीकार करने वाले को रात में मिलने के समय गुप्त स्थान में छिपे हुए लोग शस्त्र और विष से मरवा दें।
english: Those concealed in a hiding-place should have the one who has agreed killed at night, at the meeting, with weapon and poison.
notes: sattra follows the glossary (hiding-place, ambush); it could also be 'concealed as/by secret agents'. rasa = poison.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं रात्रौ सत्त्रच्.छन्नाः समागमे शस्त्र.रसाभ्यां घातयेयुः
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ rātrau sattrac.channāḥ samāgame śastra.rasābhyāṃ ghātayeyuḥ

words.gloss: of holy men, ascetics, caityas, stūpas and images of deities
come up by underground chamber and tunnel, entered into walls

hindi: अथवा सिद्धों, प्रव्रजितों, चैत्यों, स्तूपों और देवताओं की प्रतिमाओं के बार-बार जाने पर, तीक्ष्ण, जो भूमिगृह और सुरंग से चढ़कर आकर दीवार में घुसे हों, शत्रु पर प्रहार करें।
english: Or, on the frequent visits to holy men, ascetics, caityas, stūpas and images of deities, assassins who have come up by way of underground chambers and tunnels, and entered into walls, should strike down the enemy.
notes: The compound bhūmi-gṛha-suruṅgā-ārūḍha-bhitti-praviṣṭāḥ is loose: ārūḍha (mounted, risen) is read 'come up'. param is 'other', i.e. the enemy. The dvandva reading of siddha-pravrajita-caitya-stūpa-daivata-pratimānām is kept; pratimā could instead govern the series ('images of holy men, ascetics, ...'), cf. daivata-pratimā 'image of a deity' in units 25 and 27.
lines_deva: सिद्ध.प्रव्रजित.चैत्य.स्तूप.दैवत.प्रतिमानाम् अभीक्ष्ण.अभिगमनेषु वा भूमि.गृह.सुरुङ्ग.आरूढ.भित्ति.प्रविष्टास् तीक्ष्णाः परम् अभिहन्युः
lines_iast: siddha.pravrajita.caitya.stūpa.daivata.pratimānām abhīkṣṇa.abhigamaneṣu vā bhūmi.gṛha.suruṅga.ārūḍha.bhitti.praviṣṭās tīkṣṇāḥ param abhihanyuḥ

hindi: जिन स्थानों में जिन प्रेक्षाओं को राजा स्वयं देखता है, जहाँ यात्रा और विहार में आनन्द लेता है अथवा जल में क्रीड़ा करता है,
english: In whichever places the king himself watches whichever spectacles; where he delights in a procession and promenade, or where he sports in the water,
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. yātrā-vihāra read as 'procession and pleasure outing' (dvandva); it could be one idea ('pleasure procession').
lines_deva: येषु देशेषु याः प्रेक्षाः प्रेक्षते पार्थिवः स्वयम्
यात्रा.विहारे रमते यत्र क्रीडति वा-अम्भसि
lines_iast: yeṣu deśeṣu yāḥ prekṣāḥ prekṣate pārthivaḥ svayam
yātrā.vihāre ramate yatra krīḍati vā-ambhasi

words.gloss: in those beginning with the utterance of 'fie'
in childbirth, the dead and illnesses

hindi: धिक्कार-कथन आदि सभी में, अथवा यज्ञों और प्रहवणों में, प्रसूति, मृतक और रोगों में, अथवा प्रीति, शोक और भय में,
english: in all [occasions] beginning with the utterance ‘fie’, or in sacrifices and prahavaṇas; in childbirth, deaths and illnesses; or in joy, grief and fear,
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. dhik-ukti-ādi is obscure and is rendered literally ('beginning with the utterance of fie'). sūtikā = a woman in childbed / childbirth; preta = the dead, a deceased person.
lines_deva: धिग्.उक्त्य्.आदिषु सर्वेषु यज्ञ.प्रहवणेषु वा
सूतिका.प्रेत.रोगेषु प्रीति.शोक.भयेषु वा
lines_iast: dhig.ukty.ādiṣu sarveṣu yajña.prahavaṇeṣu vā
sūtikā.preta.rogeṣu prīti.śoka.bhayeṣu vā

words.gloss: at a festival of his own people

hindi: अथवा स्वजनों के उत्सव में, जिसमें वह विश्वास के कारण प्रमाद में पड़ जाता है, जहाँ दुर्दिन में या भीड़ में उसके रक्षकों का चलना-फिरना होता है,
english: or at a festival of his own people at which, out of trust, he falls into carelessness; where [there is] movement of his guards in bad weather or in crowds,
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. The predicate of the second line is missing; only a bare copula is supplied. The likely intent (that the guards' movement is hindered there) is an interpretation and is not rendered. saṅkula can also be 'crowded places'.
lines_deva: प्रमादं याति यस्मिन् वा विश्वासात् स्व.जन.उत्सवे
यत्र-अस्य-आरक्षि.सञ्चारो दुर्दिने सङ्कुलेषु वा
lines_iast: pramādaṃ yāti yasmin vā viśvāsāt sva.jana.utsave
yatra-asya-ārakṣi.sañcāro durdine saṅkuleṣu vā

hindi: ब्राह्मण के स्थान में आग लगने पर, अथवा सुनसान स्थान में भी प्रवेश करने पर; वस्त्र, आभरण और माल्यों की फेलाओं से, शय्याओं और आसनों से,
english: or at a Brahmin's place when it is ablaze, or when [he] has entered even a deserted place; with phelās of garments, ornaments and garlands, with beds and seats,
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. phelā is obscure and left untranslated; no sense is assumed. vipra-sthāna read 'a Brahmin's place'. 'he' in praviṣṭe is supplied.
lines_deva: विप्र.स्थाने प्रदीप्ते वा प्रविष्टे निर्जने ऽपि वा
वस्त्र.आभरण.माल्यानां फेलाभिः शयन.आसनैः
lines_iast: vipra.sthāne pradīpte vā praviṣṭe nirjane 'pi vā
vastra.ābharaṇa.mālyānāṃ phelābhiḥ śayana.āsanaiḥ

hindi: मद्य, भोजन और फेलाओं से, अथवा वाद्यों के साथ, साथ आए हुए तीक्ष्ण पहले नियुक्त किए हुओं के साथ शत्रु पर प्रहार करें।
english: with liquor, food and phelās, or with musical instruments, [they] having approached together, the assassins should strike the enemy together with those previously placed.
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. 'saha' in the first line is read with abhigatāḥ ('approached together'); praṇihita = placed, deployed (agents).
lines_deva: मद्य.भोजन.फेलाभिस् तूर्यैर् वा-अभिगताः सह
प्रहरेयुर् अरिं तीक्ष्णाः पूर्व.प्रणिहितैः सह
lines_iast: madya.bhojana.phelābhis tūryair vā-abhigatāḥ saha
prahareyur ariṃ tīkṣṇāḥ pūrva.praṇihitaiḥ saha

hindi: जैसे वे शत्रु के यहाँ सत्र-हेतुओं से प्रवेश करें, वैसे ही निकल भी जाएँ; इस प्रकार योग-वामन कहा गया।
english: As they would enter [the quarters] of the enemy by sattra-means, just so they should depart; thus the yoga-vāmana has been stated.
notes: Continuity: units 45 to 50 are one long sentence (the occasions for the assassins' attack) that ends at 49b/50; the edition's grouping into numbered verses is kept. sattra-hetu is obscure ('causes/pretexts of a sattra'; sattra = hiding-place or secret agency); kept literal. yoga-vāmana (vāmana = vomiting out, ejecting) is the title of the topic; rendered by its name. dviṣataḥ is genitive ('of the enemy') with a place understood, which is supplied in brackets.
lines_deva: यथैव प्रविशेयुश् च द्विषतः सत्त्र.हेतुभिः
तथैव च-अपगच्छेयुर् इत्य् उक्तं योग.वामनम्
lines_iast: yathaiva praviśeyuś ca dviṣataḥ sattra.hetubhiḥ
tathaiva ca-apagaccheyur ity uktaṃ yoga.vāmanam
